items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday, second straight DNP after exiting Week 4 early; week-to-week per prior reports, status doubtful for London game vs JAX.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-hamstring; no on-field work.
items.implication: High risk OUT; monitor Fri designation.
items.opportunity: Lead back role opens for remaining RBs.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday after also missing Wednesday; trending toward missing Week 5 vs JAX.
items.implication: Likely OUT or GTD; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other Eagles WRs/TEs if OUT.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) did not practice Thursday; Friday practice critical for Sunday Night availability vs ATL, outside chance per earlier reports.
items.why: Missed Wed/Thu after leaving Week 4 early; treatment ongoing.
items.implication: GTD or OUT possible; Huntley would start.
items.opportunity: If OUT, downgrade Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume slightly but stack risk.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.why: Shoulder issue from prior; missed Thursday.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; possible limited or OUT.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) no practice again Thursday, second consecutive DNP; status uncertain vs DEN.
items.why: Consecutive absences on foot injury from Week 4.
items.implication: Elevated OUT risk; monitor for Friday.
items.opportunity: Targets to Quentin Johnston/other Chargers WRs.

items.text: If Breece Hall out, Berry has Braelon Allen as top-20 RB this week; full prior workload (94% snaps, all touches Week 4).
items.why: Hall absence locks Allen into lead role with proven high usage.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis) injury; coach says will miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Extended absence; targets free up in PIT.

items.text: Adam Levitan and Evan Silva: Will Shipley expected to lead Eagles RB room vs JAX after Barkley (hamstring) and Bigsby injuries; 'Will Shipley show'.
items.why: Barkley/Bigsby out; Shipley last man standing, Pierce signed but Shipley favored.
items.implication: Waiver/start candidate if Barkley OUT; volume opportunity vs soft JAX receiving to RBs.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, possible receiving work expand.
items.conflict: Dameon Pierce signed to active may split.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) no practice Wednesday/Thursday, week-to-week and doubtful for Week 5 vs CLE after missing Week 4.
items.why: Continued absence post-quad injury; coach week-to-week.
items.implication: Expected OUT; full workload to backup.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen lead back with high snap/touch share.

items.text: Broncos coach Sean Payton taking over offensive play-calling from OC Davis Webb this week; collaborative but Payton has final say.
items.why: Payton confirmed change to boost offense.
items.implication: Potential scheme/pace shift for Bo Nix, RBs, WRs.
items.opportunity: Monitor for increased aggression or efficiency.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN as WR8; strong volume including red zone vs weak Titans pass D.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift; red-zone usage.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injury context (Chase/Higgins) and soft Miami run D.
items.why: Volume secure; pass-game pie if WRs limited; matchup.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) and Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17); tough matchups, thin roles, usage concerns; Addison injury wrinkle.
Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs. xFP data available for subscribers.
items.why: Actual FP vs expected on volume shows efficiency edge for Bijan/Kyren.
items.implication: Sustain or buy high on overperformers; fade/caution under.
items.opportunity: Role/volume confirmed strong for over; regression risk under.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown this week.
